title: Minimum Number of Operations to Make Elements in Array Distinct
summary: Given an integer array nums, you must make all elements distinct by removing up to three elements at a time from the start of the array.
statement: Given an integer array nums, you must make all elements distinct by removing up to three elements at a time from the start of the array. If fewer than three elements remain, remove them all. Return the fewest operations required to achieve distinct elements.
constraints: One operation removes the first three remaining elements; if fewer than three remain, it removes all of them.
Stop when the remaining array has pairwise distinct values.
Return the minimum number of operations.
reference_solution:
def minimum_prefix_triple_removals_for_distinct(nums):
    operations=0
    while len(nums)-3*operations>0:
        remaining=nums[3*operations:]
        if len(remaining)==len(set(remaining)):break
        operations+=1
    return operations
